question: Which department's Disaster Management Division organised the conference on 'Experience Sharing and Capacity Building in Disaster Management' in August 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Department of Telecommunications (DoT)**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Department of Telecommunications (DoT) organized the conference on "Experience Sharing and Capacity Building in Disaster Management" in August 2024**.
 
• The conference **was held in collaboration** with the National Telecommunications Institute for Policy Research, Innovation, and Training (NTIPRIT) and LSA, Delhi.
 
• The **conference's goal was to improve disaster preparedness and resilience in India**
 
• The** National Institute of Disaster Management (NIDM) is the capacity building arm at the national leve**l.
 
• State Administrative Training Institutes and other training institutes also perform capacity building functions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• National Institute of Disaster Management (NIDM):

 
 
• It is a Premier Institute for Training and Capacity Development programs for managing Natural disasters in India, on a national as well as on a regional basis.
 
• The National Centre of Disaster Management (NCDM), constituted under an Act of Parliament in 1995 was renamed to give the present name of the National Institute of Disaster Management (NIDM) by the Disaster Management Act 2005, passed by the President of India on 9 January 2006.
 
• The main objective of the National Institute of Disaster Management (NIDM) is To work as a Consulting Agency for the Government of India by providing Assistance in policy formulation and to facilitate in Reducing the Impact of Natural Disasters through its Technological innovations.
 
• The organization is Presided by the Union Home Minister of India.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Communications**
 
 
• **Ministry of Communications is a Central ministry** under the Government of India responsible for telecommunications and postal service.
 
• It was carved out of** Ministry of Communications and Information Technology on 19 July 2016.​**
 
• **It consists of two departments viz. Department of Telecommunications and the Department of Post**s.
 
 
 
• **National Disaster Response Force (NDRF)****​**
 
 
• The National Disaster Response Force (NDRF), constituted under Section 46 of the Disaster Management Act, 2005​.
 
• The National Disaster Response Force is administered by the Union Home Minister. Which is the apex decision-making body before, during, and after a disaster.
 
• It is managed by the Central Government of India to control the expenses for emergency response, relief, and rehabilitation due to any threatening disaster situation or disaster in the country.
 
• This fund helps the State Disaster Response Force, in case of a disaster of severe nature, provided adequate funds are not available in SDRF.
 
• The Centre contributes 75% of the SDRF allocation for general category States and Union Territories and 90% for some special hilly states of India.
 
• This fund is financed through the levy of a cess on certain items, chargeable to excise and customs duty, and approved annually through the Finance Bill.
 
 

5c:T
